label: Controller to I2C module
description: A controller powers a low-voltage I2C module and connects SDA/SCL signal lines with a shared ground.

label: Controller to I2C text display
description: A controller powers a low-voltage I2C OLED or LCD text display and connects SDA/SCL signal lines with a shared ground.

label: Controller distance sensor readout on I2C display
description: A controller powers an HC-SR04 distance sensor and an I2C display, sends a trigger pulse, reads the echo pulse, and displays the measured distance.

label: Controller single-wire sensor readout on I2C display
description: A controller powers a single-wire digital environmental sensor and an I2C display, reads the sensor data line, and displays the measured value.

label: Controller I2C protocol sensor readout on I2C display
description: A controller powers a low-voltage I2C sensor and an I2C text display, shares SDA/SCL, and shows a qualitative classroom readout.

label: Controller clocked-data sensor readout on I2C display
description: A controller powers a low-voltage clocked-data sensor such as HX711, reads data/clock pins, and shows a qualitative value on an I2C display.

label: Controller SPI protocol sensor readout on I2C display
description: A controller powers a low-voltage SPI sensor module, connects SCK/MOSI/MISO/CS to digital pins, and displays a qualitative readout on an I2C text display.

label: Controller UART protocol sensor readout on I2C display
description: A controller powers a low-voltage UART sensor, connects sensor TX to controller RX, and shows a qualitative classroom readout on an I2C display.

label: Controller UART communication module status display
description: A controller powers a UART communication module, crosses TX/RX, and shows qualitative command/status activity on an I2C display.

label: Controller SPI communication module status display
description: A controller powers an SPI communication module, connects clock/data/select pins, and shows qualitative bus/status activity on an I2C display.

label: Controller RS-485 transceiver status display
description: A controller powers an RS-485 transceiver module, crosses RO/DI UART direction pins, drives the enable pin, and shows qualitative bus activity.

label: Wireless command-state simulation boundary
description: Wireless modules expose local UART/SPI command-state and status simulation only; internet, cloud, phone pairing, SMS/calls, RF range, tracking, and security effects are outside scope.

label: Controller logic interface state display
description: A controller powers a logic interface IC, drives the required GPIO control pins, and shows qualitative interface state on an I2C display without inferring hidden output loads.

label: Controller I2C interface IC state display
description: A controller powers an I2C interface IC, shares SDA/SCL with the interface and display, and shows qualitative state without claiming calibrated measurements or hidden external loads.

label: Controller SPI interface IC state display
description: A controller powers an SPI interface IC, connects clock/data/select signals, and shows qualitative bus or ADC state on an I2C display.

label: Controller analog or timing interface state display
description: A controller powers a timer or op-amp interface IC and displays qualitative signal-conditioning or timing state without exact analog design claims.

label: Single-channel level-shifted signal context
description: A controller powers high- and low-voltage reference rails on a level-shifter module, shares common ground, and shows qualitative translated signal state for the exposed HV1/LV1 pair.

label: Controller digital output through series current limit
description: A controller GPIO drives a DC load through a required current-limiting passive before returning to ground.

label: Controller switch input plus protected digital output
description: A controller reads a switch input while driving a current-limited digital load with a shared ground.

label: Controller switch input plus protected and direct digital outputs
description: A controller reads one switch input while driving a protected LED load and a separate low-current output load with a shared ground.

label: Controller direct low-current output load
description: A controller drives a low-current output module directly from a GPIO and closes the return path to ground.

label: Controller PWM actuator
description: A controller provides supply, ground, and PWM signal activity to a beginner-safe actuator module.

label: Controller analog input maps to PWM LED output
description: A controller reads a low-voltage analog divider on A0 while driving a current-limited LED from a PWM pin.

label: Controller analog threshold controls protected LED output
description: A controller reads a low-voltage analog sensor and switches a current-limited LED when the threshold condition is met.

label: Controller analog sensor readout on I2C display
description: A controller powers a low-voltage analog sensor and an I2C display, reads the sensor analog output on A0, and displays a qualitative value.

label: Controller analog sensor threshold controls protected LED output
description: A controller powers a low-voltage analog sensor, reads its analog output, and drives a current-limited LED when a threshold condition is met.

label: Controller resistive sensor voltage divider readout on I2C display
description: A controller powers a two-pin resistive sensor and fixed reference resistor as a voltage divider, samples the midpoint on A0, and shows a qualitative value on an I2C OLED.

label: Controller resistive sensor divider controls protected LED output
description: A controller reads the midpoint of a two-pin resistive sensor voltage divider and drives a current-limited LED when an educational threshold is met.

label: Controller digital input state plus I2C display
description: A controller reads a low-voltage digital input or sensor state and shows the qualitative state on an I2C display.

label: Controller digital input state plus protected output
description: A controller reads a digital input or sensor state and drives a separate current-limited LED output.

label: Controller pulse digital sensor plus I2C display
description: A controller reads qualitative pulse or frequency activity from a low-voltage digital sensor and shows the interpreted state on an I2C display.

label: Controller matrix or multi-switch input plus I2C display
description: A controller scans multiple switch, keypad, or row/column input lines and shows the qualitative key or switch state on an I2C OLED.

label: Controller dual analog joystick plus I2C display
description: A controller powers a joystick module, reads VRX/VRY on two distinct analog inputs and SW on a digital input, then displays qualitative position.

label: Controller rotary encoder plus I2C display
description: A controller powers a rotary encoder, reads distinct CLK/DT/SW digital inputs, and shows qualitative direction/count state on an I2C OLED.

label: Controller to bare single-digit 7-segment display
description: A controller drives one or more exposed LED segment pins through individual current-limiting resistors and returns the common display pin to ground.

label: Controller to LED array display module
description: A controller powers a low-voltage LED array display module and drives data plus optional clock/chip-select control lines with a shared ground.

label: Controller to addressable LED display
description: A controller powers an addressable RGB LED module and sends a single data signal to DIN with a shared ground.

label: Controller to SPI display module
description: A controller powers a low-voltage SPI display module and drives data, clock, chip-select, and optional display control/reset lines with a shared ground.

label: Controller to common-cathode RGB LED
description: A controller drives one or more RGB LED color anodes through separate current-limiting resistors while the common cathode returns to ground.

label: Controller to powered light module
description: A controller powers a low-voltage light module, shares ground, and uses a digital signal pin for on/off state.

label: Controller PWM servo with external-power warning
description: A controller provides PWM signal and a common reference to a high-torque servo model while keeping the real-hardware external power warning explicit.

label: Controller low-side NPN transistor switched load
description: A controller drives a base resistor into a low-side NPN transistor so an external low-voltage motor-like load can switch without drawing load current from GPIO.

label: Controller MOSFET/module switched load
description: A controller drives a MOSFET module or self-contained motor module so low-voltage motor-like loads use a separated load current path and a low-current control signal.

label: Controller ULN2003 unipolar stepper driver
description: A controller sends four phase signals into a ULN2003 driver module so a 28BYJ-48 stepper can rotate qualitatively without driving coils directly from GPIO.

label: Controller STEP/DIR bipolar stepper driver
description: A controller sends STEP and DIR logic into an A4988/DRV8825-style driver, which drives the two qualitative coil pairs of a NEMA 17 stepper.

label: Controller H-bridge DC motor driver
description: A controller sends enable and direction signals into an L293D/L298N-style H-bridge so a small DC motor can change direction without drawing motor current from GPIO.

label: Controller relay module with low-voltage contact load
description: A controller drives a relay module input while the relay contact side switches only a low-voltage classroom load path.

label: External low-voltage source to breadboard rails
description: A declared low-voltage source or connector provides a positive rail and a ground reference to the breadboard without claiming calibrated current capacity.

label: External low-voltage source through 7805 regulator
description: A declared external low-voltage input feeds a 7805 regulator whose OUT pin provides a qualitative 5V rail with shared ground.

label: Passive protection or filtering component context
description: A low-voltage passive protection/filtering part is represented with pin, polarity, and placement evidence as state-only context; passive-only circuits do not generate active current-flow animation.

label: Timing passive context-only model
description: A crystal or timing passive is represented as a qualitative clock/reference context with no oscillator, timing-accuracy, RF, or active current-flow simulation.

label: Prototyping surface context-only model
description: A breadboard, perfboard, PCB blank, or Uno prototype shield is represented as placement/build context with visible anchors and warnings; it does not create current flow by itself.

label: Connector wiring context-only model
description: A header strip or terminal block is represented as connector context with pin anchors and low-voltage safety policy; it does not create source voltage or inferred nets without explicit wiring.

label: Controller board pin-map substitution context
description: A supported controller board is represented with board-specific visual pins and explicit pin-map context without assuming Uno header geometry.

label: Controller board voltage-domain policy context
description: A supported controller board exposes its 5V or 3.3V logic domain so later circuit bundles cannot silently apply Uno voltage assumptions.
